scope: Descriptive paired common-development analysis only; old holdout reused for adaptive tuning, not an unbiased final test
temperature_boundary_source: Actual species temperatures of the same original 750 heldout states; fixed across all model comparisons
notes: No training, PV generation, model changes, or new test/evaluation reads.
All L2 truths are the same lowpass Fourier targets used by common_validation_audit.
Groups may differ jointly in temperature, density, shape and flow. Associations do not identify causes or prove non-identifiability without density input.
Worst-tail memberships are defined globally per species/model, not recomputed inside each stratum.
No confidence intervals or causal claims are inferred from these descriptive group summaries.

e.worst_definition: Largest ceil(0.05*750)=38 relative-L2 errors separately for each model and species; descriptive worst tail, not a physical failure threshold
